summary: Tested the catalog-priority fix on the loadtest business (Sunrise Coffee, bid 4f0dbc25-...). (1) User's history-bias bug: I asked 'What do you sell?' with 0 products (the AI said 'coffee shop, we don't sell digital accounts'), then created Gemini Pro 10$ with an image and asked 'I saw you sell something, what is it?' in the same session. It passed 3/3: the AI named Gemini Pro and $10, never mentioned team follow-up, and the product attachment had the right media_id. (2) General question in Khmer 'បងលក់អ្វីខ្លះ?' and in English 'What do you sell?' with 6 products (4 with images): all 6 product attachments came back each time. Specific question 'anything for design under 6 dollars?' returned only Canva Pro (1 match). (3) Khmer voice via /public/{bid}/voice with a clip I made through /voice/test (HF VoxCPM2 worked): passed 2/2. Each reply had a voxcpm2-hf audio attachment plus all 6 product attachments, no '[[show' in the text, about 22 s. (4) /api/ai/test 'what do you sell?' returned 6 products, and the Settings AI test box UI shows 6 cards. (5) Embed widget at 1920 shows 6 cards with photos, name and price, and placeholders for products without images. At 390 nothing overflows (scrollWidth 390). (6) Unit test of deliver() with httpx mocked passed 5/5: 1 photo uses sendPhoto, 2-10 use sendMediaGroup with attach://pN and per-photo captions, image-less products go in one sendMessage, voice goes out as sendVoice then the album, and split_show caps at 10.

minor.issue: Claude sometimes ignores 'Plain text only, no markdown' and returns '• **CapCut Pro** – video editing ($6/month)' lists. The widget shows literal ** asterisks (seen in the 1920 screenshot), and Telegram/Messenger sendMessage (no parse_mode) will too. Another reply had an emoji and a blank-line list. Suggested fix: strip markdown in split_show (e.g. re.sub(r'\*\*|__|^#+\s*', '', ...)) or say 'never use ** or bullet markdown' in catalog_text.
If sendMediaGroup fails (e.g. one bad/oversized image -> 400), there is no fallback, so the customer gets no product photos or names. Suggest: on a non-200 album response, send the captions as text.

issues: Product cards (~175px wide) wrap one per row, so 6 cards make about 1100px of vertical scroll. Consider a 2-column grid or a horizontal scroll row on mobile. No overflow.

action_items: Strip markdown (** bullets) from AI replies, or tighten the prompt, so the widget and Telegram don't show literal asterisks in product-list replies
Optional: fallback text when Telegram sendMediaGroup fails
Optional: compact product card layout on mobile (2-column grid)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1257 lines; it should be split (AI/prompt, channels/deliver, products, voice).
catalog_text sends the full catalog (up to 300 products x 160 chars) in every prompt. That is fine now but costs tokens for large catalogs.
Messenger path in deliver() sends one image and one text per product (up to 20 API calls for 10 products). Consider a generic template carousel.

success_rate.backend: 100% (history bias 3/3, general KM/EN 2/2, specific 1/1, ai_test 1/1, voice 2/2, deliver unit 5/5)
success_rate.frontend: 100% functional (markdown asterisk cosmetic issue from LLM output)
